title: Rahmani 2025 3-second looming PPS
citation: Rahmani, M. M. H., Roel Lesur, M., & Tajadura-Jiménez, A. (2025). The impact of looming sound duration on peripersonal space measurement. Proceedings of Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025, 3549–3556.
notes: The 3-second audio-tactile assessment preserves the seven nominal touch delays and matched tactile-only baselines. The toolkit runs the 245-trial assessment with a synthesized right-lateral pink-noise path, a 1,000 ms silent lead-in and the reported 80 Hz, 200 ms sawtooth drive. Use the published fixation display, questionnaire and calibrated apparatus for a study replication.

reference_parameters.source_scope: 3-second duration condition of the within-participant experiment. Participants also completed the other duration in a semi-counterbalanced order (seven 2 s first, six 3 s first).
reference_parameters.soa_reference: Nominal trial onset, 1000 ms after fixation cross appearance. Sound starts at this onset in paired and catch trials. Tactile-only trials use the same nominal reference in silence.
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 245 trials per duration: 112 paired (seven delays × 16), 112 tactile-only (the same seven delays × 16) and 21 sound-only catches.

published_trajectory.direction: Approach from the right toward the listener’s head
published_trajectory.preview_height_reference: Listener head-center plane. This is a horizontal preview convention.
published_trajectory.preview_minimum_radius_scope: The toolkit trajectory editor requires a positive endpoint. Its Python rendering reference additionally floors distance gain at 5 cm. Scheduled distance labels retain the paper-based nominal model.

published_tactile_target.delivery: Audio-driven haptic actuator on a molded silicone pad, from a separate synchronized channel

reference_parameters.published_response: Speeded left-side Cherry MX Blue button press after tactile onset; withhold on auditory-only catch. RT is measured from scheduled tactile onset.
reference_parameters.preview_timing: A 1000 ms silent lead-in encodes the nominal fixation-to-trial interval. Fixation display and head-still instruction require the original study procedure.
reference_parameters.analysis_exclusions: Exclude responses ahead of touch and trials with multiple presses. Apply the reported 2.5 SD filter per delay and condition. The study combines adjacent scheduled delays into six overlapping analytic midpoints and applies a sigmoid fit threshold.
remaining_caveats: The synthesized headphone audio uses the Toolkit HRTF and virtual trajectory. The original MATLAB audio, HRTF and calibrated playback level remain unavailable.

The 1,000 ms silent lead-in preserves the fixation-to-trial interval. Run the display fixation, head-still instructions, tactile familiarization, five practice trials and follow-up questionnaire with the original study procedure.

The waveform uses a digital amplitude of 0.2 for software validation. Calibrate delivered vibration and validate the button response and device latencies before a participant run. The bundled response is a mouse proxy.

The toolkit distributes 245 trials across three balanced run blocks to provide two breaks. The original break positions and intertrial interval remain unreported. Apply the published order across the two duration profiles.
